page.layout: One column of text on the printed page, with marginal notes on the right. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Notes in the right margin beside "Canon 3.", beside "RUSSICA.", and beside "Imperium Rufficum".

main_text.p: turbaret, Sveci patruum ejus Carolum, Ducem Sudermanniæ, primo quidem gubernatorem, sed tandem A. C. 1607 Regem Sveciæ constituerunt, exclusâ penitus Sigismundi familiâ.
A. C. 1647 Cosacci & Tartari Polonia & Lithuaniam horrendum in modum vastarunt, & deinceps Ruffis evocatis ipsorum imperio sese cum magna Ruffia Nigra & Ukrainæ parte submiserunt.
